leanings.detail: Every node has an explicit lean (supports/mixed/refutes) + confidence (high/medium/low) + synthesized summary. Overall thesis (root SYN-0027, mixed/medium): for 2015-2024 US state/city MODERATE hikes, headcount effect is near-zero (Cengiz bunching = strongest integrative evidence); tension reconciled in 4 layers — monopsony/frictions, price pass-through, non-wage margins (hours/automation), distributional concentration. Competitive theory not wrong, its 'job-cut' prediction is redirected into other margins and surfaces mainly at high relative wages. Non-linearity affirmed with graded confidence stated verbatim: near-zero for moderate hikes = medium-high; turns negative at high Kaitz = medium; exact inflection point = low.
